name: backend-django-portfolio
description: Unified Full-Stack Portfolio: React + Vite + Django REST Framework

scripts.backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\manage.py runserver 8000 } else { python backend\manage.py runserver 8000 }"
scripts.migrate: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\manage.py migrate } else { python backend\manage.py migrate }"
scripts.makemigrations: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\manage.py makemigrations } else { python backend\manage.py makemigrations }"
